self_conditional_modifiers_json.description: 4pc: the equipping character's ATK is increased by 12% for 12s when they trigger a Stellar Glimmer reaction or deal Stellar Glimmer reaction DMG. Triggers off-field.

team_conditional_modifiers_json.description: 4pc: Stellar Glimmer reaction DMG dealt by all nearby party members (the wearer included) is increased by 50%. Triggers off-field, and the DMG bonus does not stack across several copies of this set in the party. Applied as stellarglimmer_dmg_, the umbrella key that reaches both Stellar-Conduct and Stellar Swirl hits, so this buff is correctly scoped for either. Stellar Swirl DMG itself is still unimplemented (no reaction constants), so a Swirl rotation has no hits for it to land on yet.
